title: Painting a Beaver Dam in Winter
content: In this newYouTube video, I do a plein-air gouache painting of a beaver dam in winter, with a light coating of snow.There was a lot of detail to capture. Since I couldn't paint every twig, I had to invent a way to suggest the detail using wet-into-wet passages and drybrush.Here are the colors I used:Titanium white (gouache)Terra rosa (watercolor)Raw umber (gouache)Cobalt blue (gouache)Cadmium red (gouache)Magenta (gouache)Cadmium yellow light (gouache)Painting tutorial:Gouache in the Wild Gumroad downloadGive Me Gouache!
